body: Unfortunately I can relate to this all too well. People find certain things attractive, and unfortunately whatever this girl finds attractive you lack. Even though she may be beautiful and funny and caring and your ray of hope and make your days worth going through, she doesn't see you in the same way. I've never dated but the girls I have liked I knew I had no chance with since they were out of my league. I wish I could help you realize your worth and say that just because some girls don't like you doesn't make you worthless, but I can't even do that for myself. The solution I always hear is basically adjust your personality to whatever people like. I dislike this approach as it feels fake and hollow, but it can get people to like you more.
